# Static AI Block

> Free copy-paste AI blocks for any static website. Each block is plain HTML and JavaScript that calls OneTag AI (https://onetagai.com/llms.txt) from the browser: one script tag, no backend. Paste a block into a page and replace YOUR_ONETAG_KEY with a free key (POST {"email"} to https://onetagai.com/api/signup; the key arrives by email).

## Blocks

- [Ask this page](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/ask-this-page.html): Ask anything about this page and get an answer from it.
- [Explain any selection](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/explain-selection.html): Select any text on the page to get it explained.
- [Summarize this page](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/summarize-page.html): Summarize this page in one click.
- [Translate this page](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/translate-page.html): Translate the whole page into another language.
- [FAQ bot](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/faq-bot.html): Answers only from your FAQ, says "I don't know" otherwise.
- [Draft a reply](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/draft-reply.html): Paste a message, get a reply in the tone you pick.
- [Rewrite](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/rewrite.html): Make any text shorter, longer, formal or friendly.
- [Extract to JSON](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/extract-json.html): Turn messy text into structured fields.
- [Smart search](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/smart-search.html): Search a list in plain words; matches light up.
- [Describe an image](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/describe-image.html): Get alt text for any image.
- [Explain code](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/code-explain.html): Adds an Explain button to every code block.
- [Quiz from this page](https://fengyiqicoder.github.io/static-ai-block/blocks/quiz.html): Turn this page into a three-question quiz.
